caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) consistently improves as the number of training examples increases (x-axis). Max is 29k examples, the full size of our dataset.

annotations.annotation: The line plot demonstrates the relationship between the number of training datasets and average performance. The x-axis is labeled "# of training dataset (k)", has a linear scale, and ranges from 5 to 30 with tick marks labeled at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Average Performance", also follows a linear scale, and ranges from 48 to 56 with tick marks labeled at intervals of 2. A single line is depicted in the plot, which is black with circular markers and has a solid style. This line begins at an x-value of 5 at slightly below 48 and moves steadily upwards, passing through points such as (10, 50) and (20, 52.2), and ultimately reaching about (30, 56). The trend shows a consistent increase across the x-axis. There is no legend attached to the plot to infer these lines.
